signin.need: The assistant works through the agent on {{computer}}, and that agent isn't signed in yet.
signin.needAgain: The agent on {{computer}} was signed out.
signin.tick: Sign the agent in to my Hoody account
signin.hint: This happens when you press {{button}}. It stays signed in until you sign out of the Hub. Its key is on the Keys page.
signin.off: The assistant can't write while the agent is signed out. Sign it in yourself in the Agent app.
signin.offMyself: The assistant can't write while the agent is signed out. Sign it in yourself in the Agent app, or use Write the code myself.
signin.busy: Signing the agent in to your account…
signin.done: The agent on {{computer}} is signed in to your account.
signin.doneContinue: The agent on {{computer}} is signed in to your account. Press {{button}} to continue.
signin.unknown: The agent may have been signed in, but we couldn't confirm it. Nothing was written yet.
signin.notDone: The agent wasn't signed in, so nothing was written.
signin.why.key: The Hub couldn't make a sign-in key for it.
signin.why.disabled: This agent is set to refuse sign-in from the Hub. Sign it in in the Agent app.
signin.why.notThisBox: The agent couldn't confirm that {{computer}} is yours. Sign it in in the Agent app.
signin.why.computerLogin: The agent has a sign-in set on the computer that the Hub can't replace. Change it in the Agent app.
signin.why.refused: The agent refused the sign-in. Sign it in in the Agent app.
signin.cancelled: Not signed in. Nothing was changed.
signin.stillFinishing: Sign-in is still finishing elsewhere. Try again in a moment.
signin.shared: You're using shared access. Only the account's owner can sign this agent in.
signin.admin: An administrator account can't sign agents in from the Hub. Sign it in in the Agent app.
signin.pickRealm: Choose a realm at the top to sign the agent in and use the assistant.
signin.sharedMyself: You're using shared access. Only the account's owner can sign this agent in. You can still use Write the code myself.
signin.otherAccount.writer: The agent on {{computer}} is signed in to a different Hoody account, so the assistant can't work for you here. To change that, sign it out in the Agent app.
signin.identity: The agent on {{computer}} hasn't said which account it uses yet.
signin.otherAccount: The agent on {{computer}} is signed in to a different Hoody account. To change that, sign it out in the Agent app.
signin.need.own: The agent on {{computer}} isn't signed in.
signin.hint.own: It signs in to your Hoody account and stays signed in until you sign out of the Hub. Its key is on the Keys page.
signin.unconfirmed.own: The agent on {{computer}} says it's signed in, but this page can't show it yet. Check again in a moment.
signin.unknown.own: The agent may have been signed in, but we couldn't confirm it.
signin.pickRealm.own: Choose a realm at the top to sign the agent in.
